intelligence.enrichment: Electrical components can be represented by standard symbols, and a circuit diagram is a representation of an electrical circuit using those symbols. component recognition + symbol choice + terminal orientation -> readable circuit diagram The learner correctly applies this rule: Electrical components can be represented by standard symbols, and a circuit diagram is a representation of an electrical circuit using those symbols. A circuit diagram is any neat picture of the parts, so exact symbols and terminal orientation are optional.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Electricity: circuits and cells. The student must decide: Decide how to translate an actual circuit into a circuit diagram. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
